description: Toggle the bot on or off for a specific contact. When bot is disabled for a contact, automated replies will not be sent.

enabled.description: Whether to enable (true) or disable (false) the bot for this contact

pause_duration.description: Optional, only when enabled is false: how long the bot stays off. A number of minutes as a string (e.g. "60" or "240", at most "43200"), "end_of_day" (until the end of today in the workspace time zone) or "manual" (stays off until someone turns it back on). Omit it to follow the workspace setting "Turn the bot back on after a manual stop" (off by default, so the bot stays off).

name: toggle_bot
